correctness.rationale: An output mark forces an occupied pair, and the cyclic 111 exclusion forces the immediate outer neighbors to zero. No two marks can be at gap 1 or 2, and filling just the occupied pairs realizes any allowed output. At gap 3 the two outer zero requirements coincide; at gap 4 there is no free site; at larger gaps the d-4 free sites form a path with no adjacent ones. This gives the product of F_(d-2) including a single marked pair followed by its own wraparound gap. At zero output the preimages are all cyclic independent sets, counted by F_(n-1)+F_(n+1) on fixing one site. Pointing an output mark multiplies by k, whereas assigning the marked coordinate gives n choices; counting ordered gap compositions therefore gives both sums, the singleton one allowing only gaps 3 and 4. For a gap series W(z), the 1/k weighting gives the formal sum -log(1-W(z)); multiplying its derivative by z introduces n, giving zW'/(1-W). Adding the zero word to the image yields the stated rational functions. The log-derivative power sums give leading Perron coefficients exactly 1; the two companion matrices are primitive (cycle lengths 1,3 and 3,4). The ratio is consequently as stated. For k≥2 the addition identity for F bounds the product by F_(n-3k+1)≤F_(n-5)<F_(n-2), and the Lucas zero fiber is strictly larger still. Choosing one representative per output is exactly the maximal injective codebook. All arguments use indexed rings and n≥5; the smaller coefficients of the rational series are only a formal extension.
residual_risks: The independent transfer computation is finite and does not imply the all-length formula; the gap decomposition does. The title's entropy refers to exponential count growth, not a Shannon entropy result.

value.rationale: For the indexed detector that reports adjacent coincident ones, one needs both the size of an optimally chosen zero-error codebook and the fraction of outputs inherently determining the input without such a codebook. The exact per-output law yields both and explains why exponentially many uniquely recoverable outputs still form a vanishing share. The constrained input is natural for separating occurrences of occupied pairs, and the classification covers every target rather than selected patterns or small lengths.
residual_risks: No efficient ranked encoder, arbitrary-noise analysis, or nonindexed necklace classification follows.
